title: Adverse Outcomes and Mortality in Liver Transplant
official: Adverse Outcomes and Mortality in Liver Transplant
summary: Prospective natural history pilot study to explore the link between muscle composition using an MRI-based Muscle Assessment Score (MAsS) and adverse outcomes in liver transplant candidates.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. All patients with end-stage liver disease undergoing evaluation for liver transplantation
2. Patient clinically indicated for MRI during transplant candidacy evaluation
3. Adult

Exclusion Criteria:

1\. Contra indication to MRI
